> 💤 Files selected but had no reviewable changes (6) > > * src/app/api/storefront/auth/google/route.ts > * src/app/api/storefront/products/route.ts > * src/app/dashboard/settings/kyc/kyc-form.tsx > * src/app/dashboard/settings/kyc/page.tsx > * src/app/onboarding/actions.ts > * src/lib/cached-data.ts > >

📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This pull request introduces a comprehensive documentation framework for SEO strategies, removes deprecated middleware, updates project dependencies, adds numerous data processing and product management scripts for a Supabase backend, includes various product data files and logs, and removes the Next.js middleware implementation. ## Changes | Cohort / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **SEO & Technical Documentation**
`.claude/SKILL.md`, `.claude/references/advanced-strategies.md`, `.claude/references/content-creation.md`, `.claude/references/diagnostic-questions.md`, `.claude/references/ecommerce.md`, `.claude/references/technical-checklist.md`, `.claude/references/topical-maps.md` | Adds comprehensive SEO reference materials covering holistic audit frameworks, entity building strategies, content creation guidelines, diagnostic methodologies, e-commerce optimization, technical checklists, and topical map creation—structured guides without code implementation. | | **Configuration & Dependencies**
`.gitignore`, `package.json` | Updates `.gitignore` with additional ignore patterns (temp data, images, middleware); bumps multiple dependencies including `@supabase/`*, `@tiptap/`*, framer-motion, next, react, and adds `@ai-sdk/rsc` and `@mycoverai/mca-javascript-sdk`. | | **Middleware Removal**
`middleware.ts` | Deletes Next.js Edge middleware implementation that previously handled API rate limiting, CSRF protection, Supabase session optimization, and custom domain routing. | | **Post Extraction & Cleaning**
`scripts/1-extract.ts`, `scripts/2-clean-audit.ts`, `scripts/3-import.ts` | Implements a three-stage blog import pipeline: extracts WordPress posts from MySQL dumps with featured image mapping, cleans content with security scanning and malware detection, then imports validated posts as drafts into Supabase. | | **Product Data Files & Results**
`apple_images_results.json`, `all_products.txt`, `products_with_timestamps.txt`, `sample_orphans.txt`, `orphaned_images_review.md` | Stores product data snapshots, Apple variant image results, product name dumps, timestamp-correlated product records, and a visual batch review of orphaned images. | | **Image Download & Processing**
`scripts/download-apple-images.ts`, `scripts/download-hp-images.ts`, `scripts/download-orphans.ts`, `scripts/apply-red-ring.ts`, `scripts/deploy-all-images.ts`, `scripts/deploy-db-update.ts`, `scripts/deploy-gaming-images.ts`, `scripts/deploy-hp-images.ts`, `scripts/prepare-upload.ts` | Scripts to orchestrate downloading product images from remote sources, applying branding effects (red-ring overlay via imgly), uploading to CDN via SCP, and updating product records with new image URLs. | | **Product Deployment & Fixes**
`scripts/fix-gaming-mismatches.ts`, `scripts/fix-hp-urls.ts`, `scripts/fix-pixel-pricing.ts`, `scripts/fix-iphone-air-name.ts`, `scripts/fix-infinix-content.ts`, `scripts/fix-new-fashion.ts` | Addresses specific data issues: corrects gaming product image URLs, applies pricing tiers for Pixel devices, fixes iPhone naming, generates Infinix product content, and purges "new-fashion" references across merchants/domains. | | **Data Matching & Correlation**
`scripts/correlate-timestamps.ts`, `scripts/match-hp-images.ts`, `scripts/match-to-supabase.ts`, `scripts/migrate-images-vps.ts`, `scripts/clean-matches.ts` | Implements fuzzy matching and timestamp-based correlation to map legacy image data to current product IDs, validate HP product-image associations, and prepare migration payloads for filesystem and database updates. | | **Product Seeding - Devices**
`scripts/seed-apple.ts`, `scripts/seed-apple-legacy.ts`, `scripts/seed-apple-accessories.ts`, `scripts/seed-iphones-new.ts`, `scripts/seed-iphones-missing.ts`, `scripts/seed-ipad-missing.ts`, `scripts/seed-macbooks.ts`, `scripts/seed-macbooks-used.ts`, `scripts/seed-macbooks-missing.ts`, `scripts/seed-missing-watches-macs.ts` | Seeds comprehensive Apple product catalogs (iPhones, MacBooks, iPads, Watches, AirPods) with EAV-compliant descriptions, pricing tiers, metadata, and category linkage. | | **Product Seeding - Brands**
`scripts/seed-oppo.ts`, `scripts/seed-redmi.ts`, `scripts/seed-itel.ts` | Seeds smartphone products for Oppo, Redmi, and itel with specs mapping, description generation, and category associations. | | **Product Seeding - HP Ecosystem**
`scripts/seed-hp-business-laptops.ts`, `scripts/seed-hp-gaming-laptops.ts`, `scripts/seed-hp-desktops-monitors.ts`, `scripts/seed-hp-laptops-v2.ts`, `scripts/seed-hp-printers.ts` | Comprehensive HP product seeding across business/gaming laptops, desktops, monitors, and printers with specs, pricing, stock management, and warranty details. | | **Product Seeding - Other Brands**
`scripts/seed-dell-laptops.ts`, `scripts/seed-lenovo-laptops.ts`, `scripts/seed-msi-asus-gaming.ts`, `scripts/seed-non-mac-laptops.ts`, `scripts/seed-gaming-products.ts`, `scripts/seed-gaming-batch2.ts`, `scripts/seed-audio-products.ts` | Populates databases with Dell, Lenovo, MSI, Asus, and gaming/audio products including gaming-specific variants (PS5 games, Victus/OMEN), with pricing models and feature specs. | | **Database Schema & Inspection**
`scripts/check-categories-schema.ts`, `scripts/check-columns.ts`, `scripts/check-products-schema.ts`, `scripts/check_image_schema.sql`, `scripts/inspect.sql`, `scripts/inspect_names.sql`, `scripts/full_product_export.sql`, `scripts/get_products_timestamps.sql` | Provides utilities to introspect Supabase table schemas, validate column structure, export product data snapshots, and retrieve timestamp-augmented product listings. | | **Product Querying & Listing**
`scripts/list-apple.ts`, `scripts/list-gaming-products.ts`, `scripts/list-baci-products.ts`, `scripts/list-elitebooks.ts`, `scripts/list-mycover-products.ts`, `scripts/list_categories.ts`, `scripts/count-hp.ts`, `scripts/check-gaming-status.ts` | Query scripts for discovering and logging product inventories, category structures, gaming stock status, and external API product lists. | | **Image Parsing & Preparation**
`scripts/parse-hp-sitemap.ts`, `scripts/prepare-visual-review.ts` | Extracts product image URLs from HP sitemap XML with quality filtering, batches orphaned images into markdown carousel reviews. | | **Variant Management**
`scripts/add-audio-color-variants.ts`, `scripts/add-smartphone-color-variants.ts`, `scripts/backfill-specs.ts` | Generates and inserts product color variants (JBL audio, smartphones) with SKU generation and pricing, populates product specification mappings. | | **Merchant & Feature Management**
`scripts/enable-blog.ts`, `scripts/restore-merchant.ts`, `scripts/check-merchant-state.ts` | Initializes merchant features (blog activation), restores merchant metadata to canonical values, audits merchant configuration and domain mappings. | | **Google Sheets Import**
`scripts/import-google-sheet-pixels.ts` | Fetches Google Pixel product data from a public Google Sheet CSV, parses specs, generates descriptions, and upserts products with category and merchant linkage. | | **Utilities & Debugging**
`scripts/filter-laptops.ts`, `scripts/execute-renames.ts`, `scripts/debug-supabase-update.ts`, `scripts/list-mycover-products.ts`, `scripts/probe-mycover-api.ts`, `scripts/schedule-sync-draft.ts` | Miscellaneous tools for filtering sourcing wishlists, executing remote file renames, debugging database updates, querying external APIs, and exploring Supabase SQL execution patterns. | | **Legacy Data**
`scripts/old_images.json` | Stores legacy product image metadata (product name, color, data URLs) for migration workflows. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~50 minutes **Areas requiring extra attention during review:** - **Data seeding scripts** (`scripts/seed-*.ts`): Verify pricing logic, description generation templates, and category/product linkage correctness; check for data accuracy and proper error handling in Supabase operations - **Image matching and migration logic** (`scripts/match-*.ts`, `scripts/migrate-images-vps.ts`): Validate fuzzy matching thresholds, slug generation consistency, and the correctness of VPS file operation commands - **Post import pipeline** (`scripts/1-extract.ts` through `scripts/3-import.ts`): Ensure SQL parsing robustness, security scanning effectiveness (malware detection), and proper handling of image validation (MIME type and magic byte checks) - **Data quality and assumptions**: Review hardcoded mappings, fallback logic, and assumptions about data structure integrity across multiple seed and migration scripts - **External API integrations** (`scripts/import-google-sheet-pixels.ts`, `scripts/list-mycover-products.ts`, `scripts/probe-mycover-api.ts`): Verify authentication, error handling, and data parsing from third-party sources

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
